en.headline: Open House Hong Kong returns with guided tours of more than 80 buildings
en.dek: The third edition of the architecture festival runs across three weekends from 28 November to 13 December, opening distinctive spaces including Villa Haw Par and the International Gateway Centre.

zh.headline: 第三屆打開香港今日展開 逾80座建築開放導賞
zh.dek: 建築節由11月28日至12月13日一連三個周末舉行，開放虎豹別墅、環球匯等特色空間供公眾導賞及參觀。

en.headline: Observatory issues Red Fire Danger Warning as risk turns extreme
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised the Red Fire Danger Warning at 6am on Saturday, warning of extreme fire risk amid very dry conditions.

zh.headline: 天文台發出紅色火災危險警告 火警風險極高
zh.dek: 天文台周六上午6時發出紅色火災危險警告，表示火災危險性極高，市民需提高警覺並採取防火措施。

en.headline: Police arrest 64-year-old over alleged indecent assault at Wong Tai Sin Hospital
en.dek: A 64-year-old discharged patient was arrested on Friday after a female staff member at Wong Tai Sin Hospital reported being indecently assaulted while on ward duty the previous day.

zh.headline: 黃大仙醫院職員疑遭非禮 警方拘捕64歲已出院男病人
zh.dek: 東華三院黃大仙醫院一名女職員周四在病房執勤期間懷疑被非禮，警方周五拘捕一名已出院的64歲男病人。

en.headline: HKUST 35th anniversary science showcase continues free at Central Harbourfront
en.dek: AIA Vitality Park event runs until 7pm today with research models, workshops and a 1991-drone light show over the harbour at 6:20pm.

zh.headline: 科大35周年成果共享節今日中環海濱免費開放
zh.dek: AIA Vitality公園活動至晚上7時，展出科研模型及工作坊，晚上6時20分維港有1991架無人機匯演。

en.headline: Giant character balloons fill Causeway Bay as Merry Balloon preview continues
en.dek: Free displays of Cookie Monster, Snoopy and other characters run on Pak Sha Road through Sunday as a preview to the December event at Kai Tak.

zh.headline: 巨型角色氣球進駐銅鑼灣 白沙道預熱活動續至周日
zh.dek: Cookie Monster、Snoopy等巨型氣球在銅鑼灣白沙道免費展出至周日，為十二月啟德大型活動預熱。

en.headline: Citybus driver suspended after Wong Chuk Hang crash injures five
en.dek: A Citybus lost control while descending Nam Fung Road on Friday evening, colliding with three other vehicles and injuring the driver and four passengers.

zh.headline: 黃竹坑城巴落斜失控撞三車 五人受傷車長暫停職務
zh.dek: 周五晚上約八時半，一輛城巴沿南風道落斜時懷疑失控，越過對面行車線並撞及鐵欄及三輛車輛，車長及四名乘客受傷。

en.headline: Hive Christmas markets open today in Sai Ying Pun and Sai Kung
en.dek: The Hive holds free community Christmas markets from 1pm to 6pm today at its Poho and Sai Kung venues, featuring local makers, food and live music.

zh.headline: Hive今日西營盤及西貢舉辦聖誕市集
zh.dek: Hive今日下午1時至6時在西營盤Poho及西貢場地舉辦免費社區聖誕市集，設本地手作、美食及現場音樂。

en.headline: Police arrest 58-year-old man over Tai Po Fu Shin Estate robbery of elderly man
en.dek: Police said a 58-year-old local man was arrested on Friday afternoon in connection with Wednesday's robbery in which an 84-year-old man was attacked and lost gold ornaments and cash worth about HK$650,000.

zh.headline: 警方大埔拘捕58歲男子 涉富善邨長者行劫案
zh.dek: 警方表示周五下午在大埔拘捕一名58歲本地男子，他涉嫌與周三富善邨一名84歲長者被襲及搶去約65萬元金飾現金有關。

en.headline: Octopus reports cyber attack affecting 7500 customers and 22000 merchants
en.dek: Octopus said it detected a network attack this morning that exposed names and photos of about 7500 customers plus contact details of 22000 merchants, with no financial losses found so far.

zh.headline: 八達通系統遭網絡攻擊 涉約7500名客戶及2.2萬商戶資料
zh.dek: 八達通表示今早偵測到系統受網絡攻擊，涉及約7500名客戶的姓名及相片，以及約2.2萬名商戶聯絡資料，目前未發現客戶有財務損失。

en.headline: Two suspected wartime bombs found at Sham Shui Po sports ground site
en.dek: Police said two small suspected wartime bombs about 5 centimetres long were found at a construction site in Sham Shui Po Sports Ground on Friday evening and removed after checks found no danger.

zh.headline: 深水埗運動場地盤發現兩枚懷疑戰時炸彈
zh.dek: 警方表示周五傍晚深水埗運動場內地盤發現兩枚約5厘米長的懷疑戰時炸彈，爆炸品處理人員檢查後認為無危險並已帶走。

en.headline: SmartPLAY booking system breach may affect 90000 users
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department said hackers accessed a function to reactivate old accounts, potentially exposing birth dates, addresses and phone numbers, and the privacy office has started an…

zh.headline: 康文署SmartPLAY康體通資料外洩或影響約九萬用戶
zh.dek: 康文署表示，黑客非法進入重新啟動舊系統帳戶功能，可能外洩出生日期、地址及電話等資料，私隱公署已展開調查。

en.headline: AFCD captures 17 unattended dogs in special operation
en.dek: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said it has captured 17 unattended dogs in 25 operations across high-risk areas since launching a four-month drive on 8 October.

zh.headline: 漁護署特別行動捕捉17隻無人看管狗隻
zh.dek: 漁護署表示，自10月8日展開為期四個月特別行動以來，截至26日已進行25次捕捉行動，共捕捉17隻無人看管狗隻。

en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes 2.11 percent higher at 22694
en.dek: The Hang Seng Index rose 467 points to close at 22694.77 on Friday, with the Tech Index surging 6.45 percent amid an afternoon rally.

zh.headline: 恒生指數收升2.11%報22694點 科指飆6.45%
zh.dek: 恒生指數周五收報22694.77點，升467點或2.11%，恒生科技指數急升6.45%，午後升勢明顯。

en.headline: Yiu Hing-leung appointed first CEO of Hung Shui Kiu Industry Park Company
en.dek: The company said Yiu, a former Hong Kong Science and Technology Parks executive, will take up the three-year post on 1 December after open recruitment and Chief Executive approval.

zh.headline: 姚慶良獲聘洪水橋產業園公司首任行政總裁
zh.dek: 洪水橋產業園公司宣布，姚慶良將於12月1日起出任首任行政總裁，任期三年，經公開招聘及行政長官批准。

en.headline: SmarTone offers 10GB free data to monthly subscribers after outage
en.dek: SmarTone said it will automatically credit an extra 10GB of local data to all monthly plan customers, including Birdie users, in the next billing cycle following Thursday’s network disruption.

zh.headline: 數碼通向月費客戶提供10GB本地數據補償
zh.dek: 數碼通表示，就周四網絡不穩事件，將向所有數碼通及自由鳥月費計劃客戶在下一個賬單月自動存入額外10GB本地數據。

en.headline: Court of Final Appeal quashes autistic man's flag insult convictions
en.dek: Five judges unanimously overturned the 2022 convictions of Wong Chun-lok after finding lower courts failed to properly assess his intent and wrongly excluded medical evidence of autism.

zh.headline: 終審法院撤銷自閉症男子侮辱國旗及區旗定罪
zh.dek: 五名法官一致裁定黃俊樂上訴得直，指下級法院未妥善評估其犯罪意圖，並錯誤拒絕接納有關自閉症的醫療證據。

en.headline: Family Style Food Fest brings chef-led outdoor event to West Kowloon this weekend
en.dek: The two-day event at the Art Park Great Lawn on 28 and 29 November features Eddie Huang, Jason Oh and David Lai alongside food stalls, music and limited Family Table seats.

zh.headline: Family Style Food Fest本周末西九藝術公園大草坪舉行
zh.dek: 由 ComplexCon主辦的兩日活動於 11月 28及 29日舉行，邀請 Eddie Huang、Jason Oh及黎國基等主廚，設美食攤檔、音樂及限量 Family Table席位。

en.headline: Police and privacy office warn of rising data breaches and precision scams
en.dek: Superintendent Rachel Hui said a single retailer breach exposed over one million customers, while the PCPD has received 330 breach notifications this year, up nearly 50 percent.

zh.headline: 警方及私隱公署警告資料外洩及精準詐騙上升
zh.dek: 網絡安全及科技罪案調查科警司許綺惠指一間連鎖零售商外洩逾百萬客戶資料，私隱公署今年接獲 330宗通報，按年近增五成。

en.headline: Central Kowloon Bypass fully opens 6 December at 7am completing Route 6
en.dek: The Transport Department said the Kowloon Bay section will open at 7am on 6 December, with a flat HK$8 toll for all vehicles and peak journeys from Tseung Kwan O to Yau Ma Tei cut to about 12 minutes.

zh.headline: 中九龍繞道十二月六日上午七時全線通車 完成六號幹線
zh.dek: 運輸署表示，九龍灣段將於十二月六日上午七時開通，所有車輛劃一收費八元，將軍澳往油麻地繁忙時段車程預計縮至約十二分鐘。

en.headline: HKCERT says AI tools help hackers find system loopholes faster
en.dek: The Hong Kong Computer Emergency Response Team said AI is making it easier for attackers to scan for weaknesses around the clock, with 4,404 incidents reported in the third quarter of 2026.

zh.headline: HKCERT指黑客用AI工具更快找出系統漏洞
zh.dek: 香港電腦保安事故協調中心表示，人工智能令攻擊者可全天候掃描弱點，2026年第三季共錄得4404宗事故報告。

en.headline: Ferry collides with floating dock off Tsing Yi oil depot, 24 injured
en.dek: Police said a passenger ferry from Sheung Wan to Shekou struck a floating dock around 9:25am, leaving 24 people injured including four in serious condition.

zh.headline: 上環往蛇口客輪青衣油庫對開撞浮船塢 24人受傷
zh.dek: 警方表示，一艘由上環前往蛇口的客輪約上午9時25分在青衣油庫對開海域撞及浮船塢，造成24人受傷，其中4人情況嚴重。

en.headline: Observatory forecasts fine and very dry Saturday, windy Sunday for Hong Kong
en.dek: The Observatory said a strong northeast monsoon will bring fine and very dry weather over the weekend, with temperatures from 19 to 26 degrees on Saturday and stronger winds on Sunday.

zh.headline: 天文台預測周六天晴非常乾燥 周日風勢頗大
zh.dek: 天文台表示，一股達強風程度的東北季候風將在周末為華南帶來晴朗及非常乾燥的天氣，周六氣溫19至26度，周日風勢較大。

en.headline: US fintech Clear Street completes acquisition of Boom Securities for Hong Kong presence
en.dek: InvestHK said the New York firm has established its first licensed base in the city after acquiring the 1997-founded online brokerage, which holds SFC licences for 18 markets.

zh.headline: 美國金融科技Clear Street完成收購寶盛證券 設香港首個持牌據點
zh.dek: 投資推廣署宣布，紐約公司在取得證監會批准後，完成收購一九九七年成立的網上經紀行，為客戶提供十八個環球市場渠道。

en.headline: Government gazettes bill for work injury compensation for delivery platform workers
en.dek: The Digital Platform Workers Compensation Bill, published today, would require food and goods delivery operators to insure workers and pay compensation for injuries or deaths, with first reading set for 9 December.

zh.headline: 政府刊憲《數碼平台工作者補償條例草案》 為外送員提供工傷補償
zh.dek: 草案今日刊憲，規定餐飲及貨品送遞平台營運商為工作者購買保險並支付工傷或死亡補償，將於十二月九日在立法會首讀。

en.headline: Asia Outdoor Pet Fest opens today at Kai Tak Sports Park East Village
en.dek: The three-day event, title-sponsored by ZA Bank, features pet markets, outdoor activities and a cat zone on more than 80,000 square feet of lawn from today to Sunday.

zh.headline: 亞洲戶外寵物節今日於啟德體育園東營開幕
zh.dek: 由ZA Bank冠名贊助的三日活動，今日起至周日在逾八萬平方呎草坪舉行，設寵物市集、戶外活動及貓咪專區。

en.headline: Customs seizes 7.3kg of suspected cannabis buds at airport, man charged
en.dek: A 23-year-old mainland man arriving from Bangkok was arrested after officers found the drugs in his carry-on baggage; he is due in West Kowloon Magistrates' Court today.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢獲7.3公斤懷疑大麻花 內地男被控販毒今日提堂
zh.dek: 23歲內地男子從曼谷抵港，海關在其隨身行李發現毒品，估計市值160萬元，案件今日於西九龍裁判法院提堂。

en.headline: Two flats burgled at Ngau Chi Wan estate during major renovation
en.dek: Police are treating the cases at Hilltop Gardens as a serial burglary after gold jewellery worth about HK$320,000 was taken from two units in the same block.

zh.headline: 牛池灣海港花園大維修期間兩單位遭連環爆竊失約32萬金器
zh.dek: 警方將案件合併列作連環爆竊調查，同座兩個單位窗戶被撬，共失約32萬元金器珠寶，暫未有人被捕。

en.headline: Open House Hong Kong returns for third edition from 28 November
en.dek: The festival of architecture and urban spaces runs until 13 December with guided tours of more than 80 buildings and specially opened sites across the city.

zh.headline: Open House Hong Kong第三屆今日起至12月13日舉行
zh.dek: 建築與城市空間節日由11月28日至12月13日，提供超過80個建築及特別開放場地的導賞團、主題步行及講座。

en.headline: Transport Department delays ride-hailing vehicle permits to early 2027
en.dek: Driving permit applications open on 30 November with no cap, but vehicle permits limited to 10,000 will not open until early next year, postponing licensed platform operations.

zh.headline: 運輸署將網約車車輛許可證申請延至明年初
zh.dek: 網約車車輛駕駛許可證下周一接受申請，數量不設上限；但一萬個車輛許可證要到明年初才公開邀請，平台未能如期在年底前營運。

en.headline: HKUST 35th anniversary Impact Fiesta opens at Central harbourfront today
en.dek: The free two-day event at AIA Vitality Park features space robots, AI cinema, mixed-reality art and a 1991-drone light show on Saturday.

zh.headline: 科大35周年Impact Fiesta今日中環海濱開幕
zh.dek: 免費兩日活動於AIA Vitality Park舉行，展出太空機械人、AI電影、混合實境藝術，周六有1991架無人機燈光秀。

en.headline: Immigration Department arrests couple over suspected passport tampering
en.dek: A 27-year-old woman and her 34-year-old boyfriend were arrested in Lam Tin after laboratory tests confirmed human alteration to a SAR passport that had missing pages.

zh.headline: 入境處拘捕情侶 涉非法改動特區護照
zh.dek: 27歲女子及其34歲男友在藍田平田邨被捕，政府化驗所證實護照缺頁屬人為造成，兩人涉嫌改動旅行證件等三罪。

en.headline: FIBA 3x3 World Tour returns to Victoria Park this weekend
en.dek: Sixteen professional teams compete at Causeway Bay on 28 and 29 November, with a free carnival village opening on Friday; Team Hong Kong is among the sides.

zh.headline: FIBA 3x3世界巡迴賽本周末重臨維多利亞公園
zh.dek: 16支職業球隊28及29日於銅鑼灣競逐，周五起設免費嘉年華；香港隊亦有出賽。

en.headline: Dairy Queen opens first Hong Kong store in Causeway Bay on Saturday
en.dek: The American soft-serve chain returns after nearly 50 years with a flagship at One Causeway Bay and plans three more outlets by year-end.

zh.headline: Dairy Queen重返香港 銅鑼灣旗艦店周六開業
zh.dek: 美國軟雪糕連鎖近半世紀後再度進駐，銅鑼灣One Causeway Bay旗艦店周六開幕，年內再開三間分店。

en.headline: Government relocates tribute flowers at Wang Fuk Court remembrance site
en.dek: Officials said the move creates space for more mourners while the flowers will be transferred to a religious venue for continued tribute.

zh.headline: 政府搬移宏福苑掉念地點花束 腾出空間供市民繼續致意
zh.dek: 政府指花束數量多，故以膠箱暫時放置並移至隣近草地，其後將逐步移送宗教場所存放。

en.headline: Worker burned in scaffolding fire at Mong Kok building
en.dek: A 55-year-old man suffered burns to his hands and legs after a fire on exterior scaffolding on Dundas Street this afternoon.

zh.headline: 旺角翠園大樓棚網起火 55歲工人手腳燒傷送院
zh.dek: 下午約5時登打士街大廈外牆棚網起火，一名55歲工人手部及小腿燒傷，清醒送廣華醫院治理。

en.headline: Four more patients carry Candida auris at Wong Tai Sin Hospital
en.dek: The hospital said the four men aged 44 to 72 showed no symptoms and were isolated after contact tracing in the same ward.

zh.headline: 黃大仙醫院再多4名男病人帶有耳念珠菌
zh.dek: 院方經接觸追蹤在同一護養病房發現4名44至72歲男病人帶菌，均無病徵，正接受隔離，情況穩定。

en.headline: India by the Bay festival opens at Asia Society Hong Kong Center
en.dek: The 11th edition runs from today to 29 November with music, dance, literature and cuisine programmes co-presented by Teamwork Arts and the Asia Society.

zh.headline: 印度海灣節於亞洲協會香港中心開幕
zh.dek: 第十一屆由今日起至11月29日舉行，包括音樂、舞蹈、文學及美食節目，由Teamwork Arts與亞洲協會合辦。

en.headline: Ombudsman launches investigation into LCSD management of public study rooms
en.dek: The probe examines reports of seat abuse, noise and misuse in library and sports centre study rooms that affect students with genuine revision needs.

zh.headline: 申訴專員主動調查康文署自修室管理 關注霸位及濫用問題
zh.dek: 公署指圖書館及體育場館自修室不時出現霸位不用、噪音氣味滋擾等情況，影響真正有需要溫習的學生。

en.headline: Privacy Commissioner urges businesses to invest more in data security amid AI-assisted…
en.dek: Ada Chung said recent breaches affecting more than one million users show hackers are using AI to speed up attacks, and organisations must strengthen systems even when using third parties.

zh.headline: 私隱專員促企業加強資料保安投資 指黑客用AI加快攻擊
zh.dek: 鍾麗玲表示近期多宗事故影響逾百萬人，黑客借助人工智能加速入侵，機構即使外判亦須負責。

en.headline: Police arrest 20 after raiding three suspected vice venues in Yau Ma Tei
en.dek: Officers detained four local men, one local woman and 15 foreign women aged 20 to 57; some face charges of managing or permitting prostitution premises.

zh.headline: 警油麻地搞破三個懷疑賣淫場所 拘捕20人
zh.dek: 行動拘捕4名本地男子、1名本地女子及15名外籍女子，部分人涉嫌經營或准許處所用作賣淫場所。

en.headline: 24/7 Fitness reports unauthorised access to membership system
en.dek: The chain said contact details, photos and, for some, identity numbers and health records of current and former members were affected; passwords and payment data were not.

zh.headline: 24/7 FITNESS會員系統遭未經授權存取 部分現有及前會員資料受影響
zh.dek: 連鎖健身中心表示上周五發現事件，涉及聯絡資料、會員照片，部分人身份證明文件號碼及健康申報資料；登入密碼及付款資料不受影響。

en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes up 260 points to end seven-day slide
en.dek: The benchmark finished at 22,226 points, up about 1.2 percent, after gains narrowed in the afternoon; turnover exceeded HK$212.4 billion.

zh.headline: 恒指收市升260點結束7連跌 報22226點
zh.dek: 指數午後升幅收窄，全日成交逾2124億元；科技指數升逾1%結束11連跌。

en.headline: Hong Kong October exports surge 65.6 percent on AI-related goods
en.dek: Census and Statistics Department figures showed exports rose to HK$764.5 billion and imports by 56.2 percent, driven by sustained strong demand for AI electronic products.

zh.headline: 本港10月出口按年大升65.6% 受人工智能相關電子產品帶動
zh.dek: 統計處公布10月出口貨值7645億元，進口升56.2%，有形貿易逆差193億元；首10個月出口升47.4%。

en.headline: Universities launch MentAl Bot to train teachers on student mental health
en.dek: The digital platform, based on WHO standards, starts with 300 teachers and 300 university students across 20 schools.

zh.headline: 三所大學推出MentAl Bot 助教師辨識學生精神健康需要
zh.dek: 平台以世衛標準為基礎，首階段涵蓋20所學校的300名教師及300名大學生。

en.headline: Transport Department to accept ride-hailing driver permit applications from Monday
en.dek: Applications open at 10am on 30 November via the GovHK portal using iAM Smart; there is no quota.

zh.headline: 運輸署下周一上午10時接受網約車駕駛許可證申請
zh.dek: 申請透過智方便在一站通專頁提交，並無配額上限，非先到先得。

en.headline: SmarTone network instability affects some areas this afternoon
en.dek: Users reported loss of mobile service from around 2:30pm; the company said services were recovering by mid-afternoon and apologised.

zh.headline: 數碼通部分地區網絡不穩 服務陸續恢復
zh.dek: 下午約2時半起有用戶報稱訊號中斷，公司表示正調查，至約3時45分逐步恢復並致歉。

en.headline: Hang Seng Index rebounds over 1.8 percent by midday after seven-day slide
en.dek: The benchmark closed the morning session at 22,373 points, up 407 points, as tech shares led a recovery from recent losses.

zh.headline: 恒指連跌七日後反彈 半日升逾1.8%報22373點
zh.dek: 恒生指數早市收報22373點，升407點，科技股帶動下從近日跌勢回升。

en.headline: Ngok Tou Tou Chinese Musical Club stages Cantonese opera at Ko Shan Theatre tonight
en.dek: The performance of a full-length opera begins at 7:30pm with tickets priced from HK$180 to HK$480.

zh.headline: 樂滔滔曲藝社今晚高山劇場演出粵劇
zh.dek: 完整粵劇演出於晚上7時30分開始，票價由180至480港元。

en.headline: Police investigate death of officer found with gunshot wound at Sheung Shui station
en.dek: A male officer from the New Territories North traffic unit was confirmed dead at the scene after a report at about 10:50am on Thursday.

zh.headline: 上水警署男警疑自轟身亡 警方正調查
zh.dek: 一名新界北交通部男警今早約10時50分被發現於警署內有槍傷，當場證實死亡，警方循自殺方向調查。

en.headline: Government to contact 13 Wang Fuk Court owners who rejected buy-out next month
en.dek: More than 96 percent of the estate’s households have signed to sell, with compulsory acquisition remaining a last resort, Deputy Financial Secretary Michael Wong said.

zh.headline: 政府下月接觸拒收購的13戶宏福苑業主
zh.dek: 財政司副司長黃偉綸表示，逾96%住戶已簽署出售協議，強制收回只會作為最後手段。

en.headline: Space Museum opens free exhibition on astronauts' life aboard Tiangong
en.dek: The display runs until 19 July next year and features a full-scale model of Hong Kong's first scientific payload on the station plus interactive exhibits.

zh.headline: 香港太空館舉辦免費展覽 展出航天員天宮日誌
zh.dek: 展覽即日起至明年7月19日，設有天韻相機全尺寸模型及互動機械臂體驗，介紹香港首位載荷專家黎家盈的任務。

en.headline: Private home prices fall 0.6 percent in October after two-month rise
en.dek: The Rating and Valuation Department index slipped to 319 points while the private rental index reached a fresh record high of 213.2.

zh.headline: 差估署：10月私人住宅樓價指數按月跌0.6% 結束兩個月升勢
zh.dek: 指數報319點，按年仍升8.17%；租金指數升至213.2，續創歷史新高。

en.headline: Truck collides with empty Light Rail train in Tuen Mun
en.dek: The MTR diverted three routes and ran free shuttle buses after the 10:30 collision at Lung Mun Road and Wu Chui Road; services began returning to normal by 11:03.

zh.headline: 屯門龍門路貨車撞無乘客輕鐵 三條路綫一度改道
zh.dek: 早上約10時30分湖翠路交界發生碰撞，港鐵安排免費接駁巴士，至11時03分宣布事件處理完畢，服務逐步回復正常。

en.headline: Fukuoka yatai restaurant Ganso Hakata Yatai opens at One Causeway Bay
en.dek: The first overseas outpost of Yatai Keiji brings charcoal-grilled yakitori, robatayaki and ramen to a 106-seat venue overlooking the typhoon shelter.

zh.headline: 福岡屋台「元祖博多屋台」進駐銅鑼灣港島壹號中心
zh.dek: 屋台けいじ首家海外分店在告士打道281號開業，設106個座位，供應炭火燒鳥、爐端燒及拉麵等福岡風味。

en.headline: Government proposes up to one year of paid sick leave for injured platform delivery…
en.dek: The Digital Platform Workers Compensation Bill sets a three-tier system based on working hours, with platforms required to carry insurance for food and goods delivery staff.

zh.headline: 政府擬為平台外送員工傷設三級制 最高可獲一年有薪病假
zh.dek: 《數碼平台工作者補償條例草案》按工時劃分三級，食物及貨物外送平台須購買保險，保障工傷及死亡個案。

en.headline: Former lawmaker William Wong sentenced to community service over CUHK drink-driving crash
en.dek: Sha Tin Court ordered 120 hours of community service, a one-year driving ban and a HK$6,000 fine after Wong pleaded guilty to four traffic offences.

zh.headline: 前立法會議員黃錦輝中大醉駕撞車被判120小時社會服務令
zh.dek: 沙田裁判法院周四判處黃錦輝120小時社會服務令、停牌一年及罰款共6000元，他早前承認四項交通罪行。

en.headline: Hong Kong writer Lawrence Pun dies at 56 after fall from North Point flat
en.dek: Police found a note at the writer’s residence indicating prolonged illness; Pun had battled thymoma and related complications since 2023 and published a final essay collection last month.

zh.headline: 香港作家潘國靈北角寓所墮樓身亡 終年56歲
zh.dek: 警方在單位檢獲遺書，指事主長期受病患困擾；潘國靈自2023年確診胸腺瘤後接受手術及電療，上月剛出版新書。

en.headline: Tung Wah social enterprises open free exhibition on dignified dining at iBakery Gallery…
en.dek: The display at Tamar Park runs until 31 March and pairs portraits of public figures with stories about adapting meals for those with chewing difficulties.

zh.headline: 東華三院社企於添馬公園iBakery舉辦「人人都可以食得好」展覽
zh.dek: 展覽即日起至明年3月31日於金鐘添馬公園添馬茶座舉行，以圖文及影像呈現不同人士的飲食故事，關注咀嚼能力減弱者的尊嚴飲食。

en.headline: Two-car crash on Sha Tin Road closes lanes and disrupts Lion Rock Tunnel
en.dek: A collision between two private cars on Thursday morning left one vehicle overturned and another on its side, forcing closures on Sha Tin Road towards Ma On Shan and intermittent shutdowns at the tunnel.

zh.headline: 沙田路兩私家車相撞翻側 往馬鞍山方向一度全線封閉
zh.dek: 周四早上約7時45分沙田路近博康商場兩部私家車相撞，一部四輪朝天、一部翻側，往馬鞍山方向道路封閉，獅子山隧道往沙田方向間封，車龍延至九龍塘。

en.headline: Police investigate death of 69-year-old minibus driver dragged under vehicle in Clear…
en.dek: A 69-year-old green minibus driver died in hospital on Wednesday evening after the vehicle rolled forward while he was outside it at the junction of Clear Water Bay Road and Tai Au Mun Road.

zh.headline: 清水灣道小巴司機被捲車底死亡 警方調查中
zh.dek: 一名69歲綠色小巴司機周三傍晚在清水灣道近大埉門路交界下車後，小巴溜前將他捲入車底，送院後不治，警方正調查事件。

en.headline: Police arrest 23 in Mong Kok raid on suspected illegal gambling den
en.dek: Officers from the Mong Kok special duties squad raided a unit on Soy Street on Wednesday, seizing seven mahjong tables and about HK$20,000 in cash while detaining 23 people for investigation.

zh.headline: 警旺角豉油街搗破非法賭檔拘捕23人
zh.dek: 旺角特別職務隊周三突擊搜查豉油街一單位，搗破懷疑非法賭檔，檢獲7張麻雀柁及約2萬元現金，拘捕23人。

en.headline: MTR Tuen Ma Line resumes after engineering vehicle fault at Tin Shui Wai
en.dek: The MTR said a defective engineering train at Tin Shui Wai Station had been moved clear by 6:20 this morning, with services gradually returning to normal after temporary delays of 10 to 15 minutes.

zh.headline: 天水圍站工程車故障已處理 屯馬綫服務逐步回復正常
zh.dek: 港鐵表示今早天水圍站有工程車設備故障，列車已於6時20分左右駛離行車綫，屯馬綫服務逐步回復正常，較早時候候車時間曾延長10至15分鐘。

en.headline: Wang Fuk Court fire marks first anniversary as community holds memorials
en.dek: One year after the blaze that killed 168 people at the Tai Po estate, religious groups are holding memorial services while the government has said it will not organise an official ceremony but will not obstruct lawful…

zh.headline: 宏福苑火災一周年 社區舉行悼念活動
zh.dek: 大埔宏福苑火災今日滿一周年，造成168人死亡。政府表示不會舉辦官方悼念儀式，但不會阻止合法悼念活動，多個宗教團體已舉行追思彌撒。

en.headline: Hong Kong Arts Festival website reports unauthorised access to ticket buyer data
en.dek: The organisers said personal data of several thousand advance ticket buyers for the 55th festival may have been accessed after detecting a breach on 23 November.

zh.headline: 香港藝術節網站遭入侵 數千名購票者資料或被非法閱覽
zh.dek: 主辦方表示11月23日發現主網站被未經授權進入，初步懷疑數千名第55屆藝術節門票預訂觀眾的個人資料可能外洩。

en.headline: Inaugural Asia Music Event opens two-day electronic music conference at Soho House
en.dek: The industry gathering at Soho House Hong Kong runs 26 and 27 November with more than 50 sessions and a closing party featuring international techno artists.

zh.headline: 首屆亞洲音樂活動今日於蘇豪會展開電子音樂業界會議
zh.dek: 為期兩日的會議於蘇豪會香港舉行，設逾50場環節，並於27日晚舉辦閉幕派對，邀請國際techno藝人演出。

en.headline: Former Tuen Mun Hospital surgeon arrested over suspected anesthetic theft
en.dek: Police arrested a 38-year-old former surgeon after a vial of pain-relief medication went missing from an operating theatre during a patient's procedure.

zh.headline: 屯門醫院前外科醫生涉盜手術室麻醉藥被捕
zh.dek: 警方拘捕一名38歲前外科醫生，事發時有病人正在手術室接受手術，一支止痛用麻醉藥不翼而飛。

en.headline: Sixth Hong Kong International Food Fiesta opens today in Cheung Sha Wan
en.dek: The free five-day outdoor event at Cheung Sha Wan Playground runs until 30 November with a Sichuan food street and limited $10 lucky bags.

zh.headline: 第六屆香港國際美食巡禮今日長沙灣開幕
zh.dek: 香港食品委員會主辦的戶外嘉年華由今日起至30日於長沙灣遊樂場舉行，免費入場，設四川美食街及限量10元福袋。

en.headline: Prince of Wales Hospital doctor arrested over alleged unauthorised examinations
en.dek: A 31-year-old doctor employed by CUHK has been suspended from clinical duties after police arrested him on suspicion of indecent assault involving two patients last month.

zh.headline: 威爾斯親王醫院醫生涉非禮被捕 院方禁止進入臨床範圍
zh.dek: 一名31歲中大醫學院醫生上月疑在兒童外科病房為兩名男病人進行未經授權檢查，警方拘捕後獲准保釋，院方已暫停其臨床工作。

en.headline: Leisure department confirms URBTIX breach involving 1.3 million users
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department said a contractor reported unauthorised access on 24 November, with names, phone numbers and emails involved but no identity documents.

zh.headline: 康文署確認城市售票網被黑客進入涉約130萬使用者資料
zh.dek: 康文署表示外判承辦商於11月24日通報系統被非法進入，初步涉及姓名、電話及電郵，並無身分證明文件資料。

en.headline: Tourism minister says visitor spending reached HK$111 billion in first half
en.dek: Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law told the Legislative Council that full-year related spending is projected at HK$238.1 billion after 11 per cent growth.

zh.headline: 文化體育及旅遊局局長指上半年旅客消費達1110億元
zh.dek: 羅淑佩向立法會表示，預計全年入境旅遊相關總消費將達2381億元，首十個月訪港人次按年升12%。

en.headline: Audit Commission urges faster recovery of HK$131 million in defaulted student loans
en.dek: The report found 9,515 default cases representing 4.2 per cent of loan amounts, with legal action not begun in nearly half after pandemic deferrals.

zh.headline: 審計署促加快追計1.31億元拖欠學生貸款
zh.dek: 報告指截至9月底有9515宗拖欠個案，佔貸款額4.2%，近半數個案在疫情延期後仍未展開法律行動。

en.headline: Customs dismantles syndicate and seizes 32 million illicit cigarettes worth HK$140 million
en.dek: Five people aged 44 to 65 were arrested after operations targeting bases in Tsuen Wan and Yuen Long; the group is also suspected of laundering HK$9.3 million.

zh.headline: 海關搞破私煙集團檢獲3200萬支香煙市值1.4億元
zh.dek: 拘捕5名44至65歲人士，行動針對荃灣及元朗據點，集團亦涉嫌清洗930萬元犯罪得益。

en.headline: Communications Authority approves HKT's plan to end 3G services on 25 February 2027
en.dek: The regulator cited the low number of affected users and HKT's support measures, including device-replacement offers, while requiring satisfactory service until the termination date.

zh.headline: 通訊局批准HKT於2027年2月25日終止3G服務
zh.dek: 通訊局考慮受影響客戶比例低及HKT的支援措施包括換機優惠，並要求在終止日前維持令人滿意的服務。

en.headline: Health Bureau launches community drug formulary with 151 medicines from 30 December
en.dek: The formulary expands coverage to urological, ophthalmic and dermatological conditions, with non-patented drugs at HK$2 per item per week.

zh.headline: 醫衞局公布社區藥物名冊下月30日推出涵蓋151項藥物
zh.dek: 名冊新增38項藥物，擴闊至泌尿科、眼科及皮膚科，非專利藥物每項每星期2元，並提供每年200元藥費資助。

en.headline: Education Bureau approves five schools for five S1 classes in 2027 allocation
en.dek: The approved schools are Fanling Rhenish Church Secondary School, HKTA Tang Hin Memorial Secondary School, Munsang College (Hong Kong Island), St Mark's School and Tin Ka Ping Secondary School.

zh.headline: 教育局批准五間中學以五班參加2027年度中一派位
zh.dek: 獲批學校包括粉嶺禮賢會中學、香港道教聯合會鄧顯紀念中學、港島民生書院、聖馬可中學及田家炳中學。

en.headline: HKMA launches CMU Digital Asset Platform for paperless bond settlement
en.dek: The DLT-based platform supports end-to-end paperless operations for debt securities and 24-hour multi-currency settlement using cash tokens.

zh.headline: 金管局正式推出CMU數字資產平台支援無紙化債券結算
zh.dek: 基於分布式分類帳技術的平台實現債券全程無紙化操作，並支援24小時多幣種結算。

en.headline: John Lee visits Wang Fuk Court residents in Aberdeen ahead of fire anniversary
en.dek: The Chief Executive met two households temporarily housed in Aberdeen, who said they expected to receive keys to new flats next month.

zh.headline: 李家超探訪宏福苑火災受影響居民稱政府持續提供支援
zh.dek: 行政長官上周六到香港仔探訪暫居居民，兩戶居民表示預計下月收取新單位鎖匙。

en.headline: Audit finds high no-show rates at children's assessment centres
en.dek: The Audit Commission said professional assessment no-show rates ranged from 11 to 25 per cent at the eight centres, and the Department of Health missed its six-month completion target.

zh.headline: 審計署指兒童測驗中心失約率高達兩成半
zh.dek: 審計報告顯示八間兒童測驗中心專業評估失約率介乎11%至25%，衛生署持續未達6個月內完成評估目標。

en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes below 22000 as earlier gains fade
en.dek: The benchmark index finished the session under the 22000 level after morning advances reversed, with technology shares among the main contributors to the decline.

zh.headline: 恒指尾市失守22000點 早前升幅消失
zh.dek: 基準指數今日下午升幅回吐，最終收市失守兩萬二關口，科技股成為主要拖累。

en.headline: Observatory expects higher coastal water levels tonight
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said the combined effect of a spring tide and the northeast monsoon may bring slightly higher water levels, with minor flooding possible in some low-lying areas.

zh.headline: 天文台料今晚沿岸水位較高 低窪地區或現輕微水浸
zh.dek: 天文台表示受天文大潮及東北季候風共同影響，預料今晚沿岸水位較正常稍高，部分低窪地區可能出現輕微水浸。

en.headline: Police reports on two closed luxury consignment shops rise to nearly HK$51 million
en.dek: Police said they have received nearly 400 reports alleging unpaid payments totalling almost HK$51.2 million after the two shops in Causeway Bay and Admiralty closed abruptly.

zh.headline: 兩間二手名牌寄賣店突然結業 警方接獲近400宗報案涉款約5120萬元
zh.dek: 警方表示已接獲近400宗報案，指銅鑼灣及金鐘兩間寄賣店拖欠款項，涉及金額約5120萬元，案件列為詐騙調查中。

en.headline: Auditor finds Consumer Council missed complaint handling targets
en.dek: The Audit Commission said the Consumer Council failed to meet reply times and resolution rates for complaints in recent years, and noted low usage of its two service centres.

zh.headline: 審計署指消委會投訴處理未達標 服務中心使用率低
zh.dek: 審計署表示消委會近年未能達到投訴回覆時限及調停成功率目標，北角及尖沙咀服務中心使用率亦偏低。

en.headline: Tung Wah social enterprises open care food exhibition in Admiralty
en.dek: The CookEasy and iBakery exhibition on soft meals runs until 31 March at the iBakery Gallery Café in Tamar Park, featuring stories from ten guests including celebrities and care home residents.

zh.headline: 東華三院社企開辦照護食展覽 展至明年三月
zh.dek: 煮餥易及愛烘焙的「人人都可以食得好 2026」展覽即日起至明年三月三十一日於添馬公園愛烘焙茶座舉行，展出十位嘉賓的飲食故事。

en.headline: Hong Kong backs APEC framework to advance digital trade
en.dek: Director-General of Trade and Industry Aaron Liu said Hong Kong will fully support the newly adopted APEC Trade Digitalisation Cooperation Framework and continue sharing its experience as an international trade centre.

zh.headline: 香港支持APEC貿易數碼化合作框架
zh.dek: 工業貿易署署長廖廣翔表示，香港將全力支持新通過的APEC貿易數碼化合作框架，繼續分享香港作為國際貿易中心的經驗。

en.headline: Tang says bid-rigging task force is already a powerful deterrent
en.dek: Security Secretary Chris Tang warned that some syndicates now fabricate repair orders to pressure owners into unnecessary works, and urged owners to check the Buildings Department site.

zh.headline: 鄧炳強指打擊圍標特遣隊已起震懼作用
zh.dek: 保安局局長鄧炳強警告有集團虛擬維修令施壓業主，呼籲業主查核屋宇署網站確認令是否存在。

en.headline: Frieren anime exhibition opens at Mong Kok INCUBASE Arena
en.dek: The Beyond Journey's End exhibition runs until 3 January at Chong Hing Square B2, with five themed areas from the first season and tickets from HK$108.

zh.headline: 《葬送的芙莉蓮》特展旺角開幕 展至明年1月
zh.dek: 展覽於11月24日在旺角創興廣場地庫INCUBASE Arena開始，設五個第一季主題展區，門票由108元起，展至明年1月3日。

en.headline: Tram hits elderly woman in North Point as services briefly suspended
en.dek: A westbound tram struck a woman at the King's Road junction with Kam Hong Street at 7:19am; she was conscious and taken to Eastern Hospital, with services on Shu Kuk Street resuming at 8:12am.

zh.headline: 北角電車撞倒過路婦 書局街西行線一度暫停
zh.dek: 今早約7時19分一輛西行電車於英皇道與琴行街交界撞倒一名婦人，她清醒送東區醫院，書局街西行電車服務至8時12分恢復正常。

en.headline: Customs seize 19kg cannabis buds at airport in two cases
en.dek: Hong Kong Customs said officers seized about 19 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds with an estimated value of HK$4 million and arrested four mainland men at the airport.

zh.headline: 海關機場破兩宗販毒案 檢約19公斤大麻花拘4名內地男子
zh.dek: 海關表示在香港國際機場兩宗案件中檢獲約19公斤懷疑大麻花，估計市值約400萬元，並拘捕四名內地男子。

en.headline: Five vehicles collide in Sham Shui Po after taxi hits motorcycle
en.dek: Police said a 25-year-old motorcyclist suffered a leg injury and a 67-year-old taxi driver reported discomfort after the crash on Castle Peak Road; both were conscious and taken to Caritas Hospital.

zh.headline: 深水埗青山道的士撞電單車醒五車相撞 兩人受傷
zh.dek: 警方表示星期二晚上約10時20分於深水埗青山道60號對開發生五車相撞，25歲鐵騎士腳部受傷，67歲的士司機報稱不適，兩人清醒送明愛醫院。
